performance.decision: User-authorized per-shape <=1% slowdown; 95% upper bound <=1.01 and stable N0/N0 controls. All samples retained. One formal paired performance protocol; no default full ABBA.

baseline_limitations: Sampled acceptance covers SM103 fixed 10 shapes x 2 seeds, predeclared domain 10 shapes x 2 seeds, and representative ABI; it is not an exhaustive proof of the dynamic shape range.

P/N and S/N timing legs were compared on the same GPU UUID and runtime on a shared ASI Pod. Cooperative device locks and idle before/after snapshots were recorded; continuous third-party GPU process telemetry during timing was not recorded. The user accepts this sampled performance evidence.
limitations: Finite fixed/domain samples and SM103 only; performance equality is resolved within observed measurement uncertainty, not an exact-time guarantee.
